signature.name: Ba Na Hills Cable Car
signature.detail: Asia's longest cable car climbs to the Ba Na Hills, a mountain resort with French-inspired architecture and themed gardens. The ride itself offers wide views over the forest and coast. Book tickets in advance and go early in the day to avoid queues at the top.

signature.name: Golden Bridge
signature.detail: A pedestrian bridge held up by giant stone hands, perched on the Ba Na Hills, and one of the most photographed sights in Vietnam. It is best seen early morning, before the crowds and haze build up. Wear comfortable shoes, as the walk includes steps and uneven stone.

signature.name: Sun World Ba Na Hills
signature.detail: The amusement park at the top of the hills, known as Fantasy Park, offers many rides, attractions and themed areas. It is the main reason many visitors stay for a full day. Combine it with the cable car ticket to save time and money.

signature.name: Marble Mountains
signature.detail: A cluster of marble hills with caves, tunnels and Buddhist shrines, with climbs offering views over the coast. It is a short trip from the city centre. Wear sturdy shoes and cover your shoulders when entering temples.

signature.name: Lady Buddha
signature.detail: A huge white statue of the Goddess of Mercy on the Son Tra Peninsula, overlooking the sea and the city. It is one of the most recognisable landmarks in Da Nang. Visit in the morning or late afternoon for softer light and fewer visitors, and dress modestly.

signature.name: My Khe Beach
signature.detail: A long sandy beach with calm water, often cited as one of the best in Vietnam. It is ideal for a relaxed swim or sunset walk. Go in the early morning or late afternoon, as the midday sun is strong.

signature.name: Dragon Bridge, Da Nang
signature.detail: A steel bridge shaped like a dragon that spans the Han River, famous for fire and water displays on weekend nights. It is a lively spot in the evening. Arrive before dark to find a viewing spot along the riverbank.

signature.name: Hai Van Pass
signature.detail: A winding mountain road with dramatic views over the coastline, linking Da Nang with Hue. It is best experienced by motorbike, car or the scenic train. Go on a clear day for the best views, as cloud often covers the summit.

food: Local bowl of mi quang or pho $2-4; mid-range seafood dinner $10-20
